_instructions: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. This array can contain multiple VPN instances.

_field_guide.phy_interface: Required for wg-raw. The physical interface name (e.g. eth0) to attach XDP to.
_field_guide.vpn_interface: Required. The name of the VPN interface to create (e.g. wg0 or neko0).
_field_guide.vpn_addr: Required. The IP/CIDR to assign to the VPN interface (e.g. 10.0.0.1/24).
_field_guide.server_bind_port: SERVER ONLY. The physical port to listen on (Raw) or intercept (WG-Raw).
_field_guide.client_remote_ip: CLIENT ONLY. The physical IP of the server.
_field_guide.client_remote_port: CLIENT ONLY. The physical port of the server.
_field_guide.password: Required. Shared secret for encryption or handshake.
_field_guide.private_key: WG-RAW ONLY. WireGuard Private Key (Generate with: wg genkey).
_field_guide.wg_internal_port: WG-RAW ONLY. Internal port for Kernel WireGuard (Default 51820).
_field_guide.tcp_mode: Optional. If true, disguises traffic as TCP.
_field_guide.custom_protocol: Optional. Custom IP Protocol number (Default 233). Set 17 for UDP.
